sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics

Another important aspect of the game is the use of obstacles and hazards. These can be anything from moving platforms to falling blocks, and require players to think on their feet to avoid them. Overall, the core gameplay mechanics in Jump or Die are simple yet challenging, requiring players to use their reflexes and strategic thinking to survive. The use of boosters and power-ups adds a new layer of depth to the game, making it more exciting and immersive.
